title: Archive manifests of version 2, contract-event evidence records and locators of versions 1 and 2
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/archive-v2-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation (standard library only) of docs/spec/archive.md's version-2 manifest, contract-event evidence and locators, reusing archive-vectors.py's version-1 encoder, and output-root.json's Base Sepolia game, header and trie nodes

rules.labels: as archive.json: label32(x) = SHA-256("archive/" + x); a fake raw CID is 01551220 ‖ label32(x'); a reference (contract, block, label) has cid 01551220 ‖ label32("evidence/" + label) and transaction label32("tx/evidence/" + label)
rules.full: archive.json's full manifest (l1ChainId 11155111, sequence 1024, 8192 objects, 1024 links) with 1024 references for i = 0 .. 1023: contract label32("contract/" + (i mod 4))[:20], block floor(i / 4), label "full-" + i, sorted by contract, block and CID
rules.max: l2ChainId and gameIndex 2^64 - 1, contract and game twenty 0xff bytes, outputRoot label32("max/root"), messagePasserStorageRoot label32("max/passer"); filled(x, n) is SHA-256("archive-v2/" + x + "/" + i) for i = 0, 1, ... concatenated and cut to n; header filled("header", 1024); nodes filled("node-" + i, 532) for i = 0 .. 63, sorted

output-root.json's l1-block vector as a record: Base Sepolia game 28322, its block's header and the account and storage proof nodes of slots 0, 1, 2, 3 of 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000015, sorted, each once (the decoder judges the form only; these slots aren't S and S + 1)
